For reference, here's what does exist on the other Field Hiring calendars (none currently have a location set):

- **Jun 21, 10:00 AM** — "Interview panel" on the autumn phone screens/offers calendar (its 11:00 AM "Logistics note" mentions onsite interviews in Building 4)
- **Jun 22, 10:00 AM** — "Interview panel" on the confidential search calendar

So as you specified — no such event found. If one of the above is the one you meant, tell me which and I'll set its location to Building 4, Room 402.
